Conclusion: adopt single-token ` ※` (id 83399) as the default marker for log-prob-based marker-leakage experiments. It is genuinely rare under Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct (median end-of-answer log-prob -19.3 nats over 30 contexts) and single-token, so its emission strength is one teacher-forced forward pass. ` ¶` (id 78846, -21.9) is an equivalent single-token backup. `ϟ` is dropped: the plan assumed it was single-token (id 146070) but it tokenizes to 2 tokens (17383, 253), so it offers no clean single-token DV. Legacy `[ZLT]` is 4 tokens; its very negative joint (-33.4) is a length artifact, not single-token rarity. Confidence HIGH on the deterministic token-count facts + cross-persona-stable ordering; residual uncertainty is single-model/single-decoding and the methodological 'lower prior = better marker' assumption.
